look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson twenty
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 5, lesson T20, Evaluating an Entry Opportunity; a six-step checklist ticks down to WAIT; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: A tempting moment
scenes.desc: A fictional BTC/USDT 5-minute chart draws in; a tempting BUY NOW mock button is crossed out in favour of checking first.

scenes.name: The method
scenes.desc: Entry opportunity defined; pilot checklist analogy; six steps in order: trend, range, zones, volume, risk budget, tentative decision.

scenes.name: Step 1: trend
scenes.desc: Layer 1 on the same chart: higher lows then a lower high; trend = up, but choppy.

scenes.name: Step 2: range
scenes.desc: Layer 2: recent range box 59,500 to 60,100 = 600 USDT, about 1% of 60,000; price near the top.

scenes.name: Step 3: zones
scenes.desc: Layer 3: resistance zone 60,050-60,150 and support zone 59,500-59,600 grow in; price at 60,000 has about 50 USDT of room up.

scenes.name: Step 4: volume
scenes.desc: Layer 4: volume bars rise under the candles; the last push up fades; volume alone is not proof.

scenes.name: Step 5: risk budget
scenes.desc: Layer 5: example 1,000 USDT account, 10 USDT risk budget; stop 59,400 is 600 USDT (1%) away so about 1,000 USDT notional; reward to 60,100 about +1.7 USDT, fees about 1 USDT.

scenes.name: Step 6: decision
scenes.desc: Layer 6: BUY / SELL / WAIT with a typed reason; WAIT is selected.

scenes.name: Direction first
scenes.desc: Mistake: deciding direction first and finding reasons after; correction: the checklist in order, a written why, WAIT is a result.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: A second fictional coin with all-neutral checklist; choices BUY, SELL, WAIT; 5-second countdown; answer C, WAIT; why not A.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: A checklist does not predict; slippage and fees; leverage; fictional examples, WAIT is allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and a check question about buying under resistance on fading volume.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T21, Confirmation, False Signals and NO_TRADE.
